title: "Base-case tree"

The code in this script runs the decision tree at the base-case parameter values, draws the tree, and saves the tables and figures shown on the [base case](results_base_case.qmd) results page.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/base_case_tree.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/base_case_tree.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/functions.R)
:::

```{r}
#| label: read-scripts
#| include: false
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/base_case_tree.R")
```

## Load the helper functions

The script first sources the [functions](functions.qmd) used to evaluate and draw the tree.

```{r}
#| label: source-helpers
#| eval: false
```

## Tree labelled with parameter names

`plot_tree_diagram_QC()` is called with the name of each parameter in place of its value, and complementary branches are labelled with their formulas. The result is saved as `figures/crag_tree_parameters.svg`, the conceptual tree on the base case page.

```{r}
#| label: parameter-labelled-tree
#| eval: false
```

## Base-case tree

`create_tree_diagram_QC()` runs the tree at the base-case values in `expected_value`. The tree is saved as `figures/crag_tree_QC.svg`, and a copy annotated with the incremental cost, QALYs and net monetary benefit of screening is saved as `figures/crag_tree_QC_annotated.svg`.

```{r}
#| label: base-case-tree
#| eval: false
```

## Path table

The pathway table lists every path through the tree with its probability, cost and QALYs. It is saved as `figures/output_table_QC.png` and `tables/output_table_QC.docx`.

```{r}
#| label: path-table
#| eval: false
```

## Parameter table

The parameter values used in the run are formatted as a table and saved as `figures/parameter_table_QC.png` and `tables/parameter_table_QC.docx`.

```{r}
#| label: parameter-table
#| eval: false
```

## Summary table

The pathway table is summed by strategy to give each strategy's total probability, expected cost, expected QALYs and net monetary value at the willingness-to-pay threshold. It is saved as `figures/summary_table_QC.png` and `tables/summary_table_QC.docx`.

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
#| eval: false
```
